title: EU AI Act Article 50 transparency obligations
description: Suggests the Article 50 transparency obligations of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 that may apply to an asset: telling people they are interacting with an AI system, marking synthetic audio, image and video output, informing people exposed to emotion recognition or biometric categorisation, and disclosing deep fakes and AI-generated text published to inform the public. Article 50 applies on top of any risk classification and has exceptions (for example where the AI interaction is obvious, or for authorised law-enforcement uses), so every match is a suggestion for a human to confirm or reject. Synthetic text generation alone is not flagged under Article 50(2), since almost every LLM asset generates text.

rules.reference: Article 50(1): AI systems "intended to interact directly with natural persons" must inform them "that they are interacting with an AI system", unless this is obvious
rules.title: AI system interacting directly with people (chatbot or assistant) must disclose it is an AI

rules.reference: Article 50(2): providers of AI systems "generating synthetic audio, image, video or text content" must ensure outputs are "marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated"
rules.title: Synthetic audio, image or video generation must be machine-readably marked

rules.reference: Article 50(3): deployers of "an emotion recognition system or a biometric categorisation system shall inform the natural persons exposed thereto of the operation of the system"
rules.title: People exposed to emotion recognition or biometric categorisation must be informed

rules.reference: Article 50(4): deployers of an AI system generating or manipulating content "constituting a deep fake", or text "published with the purpose of informing the public on matters of public interest", must disclose that it was "artificially generated or manipulated"
rules.title: Deep fakes, and AI-generated text published to inform the public, must be disclosed
